title: Widget Safety Reauthorization Act of 2099
bill_text: SECTION 1. REAUTHORIZATION. Section 5 of the Widget Safety Act (99 U.S.C. 55) is amended by striking "2098" and by inserting "2103". SEC. 2. FUNDING. Section 6 of such Act is amended by striking "$5,000,000" and by inserting "$7,000,000". This Act takes effect on October 1, 2099.
